description: This file defines a class 'Cumulative' containing static methods for calculating cumulative interest and principal payments over a period for loans, implementing Excel financial functions CUMIPMT and CUMPRINC.

classes.name: Cumulative
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate cumulative interest and principal payments over specified periods, suitable for implementation of Excel's CUMIPMT and CUMPRINC functions.

methods.name: interest
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative interest paid on a loan between the start and end periods using parameters such as interest rate, total periods, present value, start period, end period, and payment timing.

methods.name: principal
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative principal paid on a loan between the start and end periods using similar parameters.
